Senses.Explanation: The enthronement gauntlet that turns a new abbot's authority into a question demanding an instant display. Baiyu Jingsi, entering the abbot's quarters at Longhua where the old master ran his forge — bone-tapping, Buddha-smelting, nail-pulling — asks how this unworthy one will deploy, cracks his staff, and tells the hall to watch the command take effect; Guxue Zhenzhe, taking the room at Cuiyan where the ancestors pulled nails and loosened bonds for lake-and-sea monks, asks how Zhe deploys there and lets the seven-foot black rattan decide for you; Wanru Tongwei, taking the room at Caoshan, rules that Magadha's closed door and Vimalakirti's silence, though they cut off past and present, are unfit for the teaching, asks how this mountain monk deploys, and passes even the iron-browed copper heads only through the red furnace; and Jieweizhou Xingzhou, before the seat of the new Puji temple in the capital, asks how the new Puji will deploy, shouts once, and mounts the seat. Muchen Daomin, in the ceremonial-robe turn of his Tiantong enthronement, pictures shedding the jewels for hides and entering the market basket, asks how to deploy just then, and would overturn seas and ridges to find one who knows; Tianyin Yuanxiu, at the Yixing donors' xiaocan, grants heaven covers, earth generates, the king blesses, and ministers repay the state — then asks what the patch-robed one does with it, and the young Yulin, waiting at his side, overturns the incense table and cuts off the tongues of the world; Qiran Chaozhi, after quoting Dahui's bathing-the-buddha address, rules that for the supreme device the patch-robed monk's grip has not yet been dreamed of, then asks how after all to deploy — the cart is not pushed sideways, the truth not bent; and Lianfeng Su, having fallen as a young man into the old masters' pit and still unable to leap out with all his strength, asks the senior seat Langxuan how one deploys when one cannot get out, raising his whisk: flour is milled where the wheat grew, and songs must be sung in the emperor's home town.
